name: Word of Serious Healing
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level bard 3, cleric/oracle 3, druid 4, inquisitor 3, paladin 4, ranger 4, shaman 3, witch 4

This spell functions like word of light healing except except that it cures 3d4 points of damage plus 1 per two caster level (maximum +7).
